answer: An island funds navigation aids for boats that wander beyond the visible horizon. Influence equals coins irreversibly burned for this poll. Validators verify finalized burns on the ledger, reject invalid proofs and count each transaction output once across all aliases. Extra influence requires destroying more coins; reusing a wallet or submitting old burns adds nothing. This assumes ledger finality and an unspendable burn destination. Wealth buys influence; the rule does not establish unique people.
